name: execute-work
description: Implement a fixed issue list sequentially and submit independent change requests without merging.

interface.shortDescription: Implement an issue list and submit independent PRs.
interface.longDescription: Read a fixed issue list and its persisted evidence, implement and validate each independent task in its owning repository, and submit all eligible change requests without merging.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-execute-work to implement the supplied issue list and submit independent change requests without merging.
